page.overview:
What is Badd Family?

Badd Family, or also known as Badds are notorious family and hillbillies from back woods.

Mr. Badd is an unseen character from 1987 TV series. He is the father of Badd family, husband of Bedelia Badd and father of Buford and Bubba Badd.

Bedelia Badd is hillbilly and mother of Badd family. She acts as main antagonist in Donatello's Badd Time, along with her sons, Buford and Bubba.

Buford Badd is secondary antagonist in Donatello's Badd Time. Buford is son of Bedelia Badd and possibly late Mr. Badd, and brother of Bubba Badd.
